content:
Sam: Quick idea for the relaunch: try feature-fit segmentation in the nurture drip. Instead of only last-open, split by product usage signals (embeddings API, routing calls) and tailor subject + CTA.

Viv: Interesting. How many segments?

Sam: Start small: 3 segments - Explorer (low product use), Integrator (API calls but low page visits), Power (high usage). Each gets a different CTA: Explorer -> benchmarks, Integrator -> quick API how-to, Power -> invite to beta features.

Jo: Love that. For Explorer: soft nudge cadence 48h single. Integrator: 3-touch (48h, 5d, 10d). Power: targeted product update + invite only, single email.

Hannah: Can we route Integrator & Power clicks with product usage >2 in last 7d to sales? Tag = feature_fit_intent.

Sam: Yes. Sales webhook payload fields: email, user_id, tag=feature_fit_intent, top_actions, last_7d_api_calls. Jo will map.

Jo: SQL to pull segments (will validate):
```sql
SELECT id AS user_id, email, last_opened_at, region, api_calls_7d, page_views_7d
FROM newsletter_users
WHERE subscribed = true
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM suppression_list);
```
Split into Explorer (api_calls_7d=0), Integrator (api_calls_7d between 1 and 5), Power (>5).

Viv: Deliverability: canary 4% across IPs, ramp to 40% in 6h. Send windows: recipient local 10-2. esp-bot: any bounce alerts?

esp-bot: Last 30d: hard_bounce=0.38%, soft_bounce=1.0%, complaint_rate=0.02%. Recommend suppress domains with >4 bounces and do inbox previews for segments.

Hannah: Creative notes: keep the Integrator subject technical: "New API tips for lower latency"; Explorer subject curiosity-based: "What's new at Redwood Inference"; Power: "Exclusive beta: try X". A/B subjects only for Integrator segment first.

Sam: Tracking: utm_campaign=feature_fit_relaunch, utm_content=seg_Explorer|Integrator|Power + cta=benchmarks|howto|beta. Jo will export canary list to ESP staging.

Jo: QA checklist: links, UTMs, suppression import, webhook mapping, inbox previews. Timeline: canary Tue 10am PT, evaluate 24h, ramp Wed if green. Sam to approve final creative.

Viv: I'll prepare subject + CTA mockups and post screenshots here by EOD.

Sam: Thanks team. Keep initial send small — want clean signal for segment performance. :rocket:
